dependency_policy: Python standard library only; no security/authentication enforcement claim.

api.AssuranceError: ValueError subclass for unknown, incomplete, malformed or changed inputs; callers fail closed.
api.assess_repository(repo, source_commit, i: Return canonical JSON-compatible identity from actual Git objects/current bytes/observed environment. source_commit is an explicit full immutable commit id, never implicitly replaced by HEAD.
api.verify_record_update(before, after, owne: Validate parsed JSON objects recursively; return True on allowed update, otherwise raise AssuranceError. owned_fields are exact RFC6901 JSON pointers to existing scalar leaves, with /history the sole permitted container pointer.
api.compare_identity(before, after): Validate both closed identity objects and their canonical identity_sha256; return True only for type-sensitive canonical equality. Malformed/unknown identity input raises AssuranceError.

identity.repository: Observed git remote get-url origin, canonicalized only by stripping surrounding whitespace; reject absent origin. No absolute worktree path in semantic identity, so same-origin detached worktrees compare consistently.
identity.source_commit: Explicit 40-character lowercase hex commit; git rev-parse must resolve exactly that commit object; repository HEAD advancement alone is not invalidation.
identity.source_tree: Actual tree id resolved from source_commit^{tree}; full lowercase hex.
identity.assessed_inputs: Object with exact nonempty source/contracts/tests/tools lists. Entries sorted by relative path and contain path, sha256 and executable. Non-record input SHA256 is actual current raw bytes and must match immutable source_commit blob bytes/mode. Record inputs use canonical baseline parsed bytes after validating the current record against its declared mask; original anchor remains in identity.
identity.environment: Exact object containing observed runtime identifiers python implementation/version, platform system/machine plus variables for the sorted explicitly declared environment_names. Missing/duplicate/non-string variable names or missing values fail closed; no caller-supplied digests. Empty explicit variable list is valid because actual runtime identifiers remain bound.
identity.record_ownership: Immutable mapping from known relative record path to sorted unique exact owned JSON pointers. All record files already exist at source_commit and are parsed/validated against those baseline bytes, including files outside assessed input lists.
identity.identity_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 over all other identity fields serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False; raw output/result files are never inputs to their own hash.

input_manifest.categories: Each category is a nonempty list of unique portable relative file paths; duplicates within/across categories fail closed. unknown_dependencies is required and must be exactly []. No extra keys.
input_manifest.ownership: record_ownership may cover separate records or assessed contracts only; source/tests/tools entries cannot be masked. No whole-file or whole-object ownership exemption.

record_rules: Parse JSON strictly: reject duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, invalid JSON and non-object root; reject non-JSON Python values in direct API objects.
Owned pointers name existing scalar leaves, never an ancestor object/list; reject duplicate, overlapping, escaping, missing or malformed pointers. The exact /history exception names an existing list.

Preserve all object key sets, nesting and nonowned values with type-sensitive canonical comparison; bool is distinct from int. New/removal of fields is denied, including owned fields. Owned scalar changes retain their JSON type.

If history exists, it must remain a list and the entire original prefix must be identical with type-sensitive comparison. Append is permitted only when /history is explicitly owned; otherwise history must remain exactly unchanged.
Record continuity means every assessed input, mask and observed environment value remains identical. Canonical identity excludes ambient HEAD; actual candidate change enumeration remains mandatory.
candidate_change_detection: Enumerate actual tracked delta between source_commit and current working tree, including staged/unstaged content, modes, renames/deletions, plus ALL untracked files including ignored files, excluding Git administrative metadata only. Each changed path must be an explicitly declared record_ownership path and independently pass parsed mask/history validation; every other changed, missing or unknown path fails closed, even outside assessed lists. Ignored executable/source/build inputs receive no trust exemption. Real scratch Git fixtures isolate these observations from ambient workstation files.
path_safety: Reject absolute paths, empty/dot/dotdot segments, backslashes, .git segments, missing files, directories, symlinks in any path component and git symlink/submodule modes. Actual repository root must equal git toplevel; Git worktree administrative .git pointer is not an assessed input. Require regular tracked baseline files, readable bytes, consistent executable bit, no ambiguous path aliases.
cli: assess --repo ROOT --source-commit HEX --inputs FILE --environment-names FILE [--record-ownership FILE]: strict JSON inputs; print identity only after complete success.
compare --before FILE --after FILE: parse and validate identity JSON; exit 0 iff equal, 1 for drift.
record --before FILE --after FILE --owned-fields FILE: validate parsed update; exit 0 iff allowed.
failure_policy: Successful operations exit 0. Drift, malformed/missing data, unknown dependencies or unsafe paths exit nonzero with concrete stderr diagnostic; argparse rejects unknown commands/options. No fallback PASS or setup-error substitution.
acceptance_runner: Evaluator independently authors tools/test_workflow_assurance.py with the eleven fixed --case names from feature_list_017.json; each uses real scratch Git repository fixtures with origin and committed anchors, observed environment changes, explicit concrete assertions and intended API baseline failure. Unknown cases/checks exit nonzero; later stage --check interfaces stay unavailable/nonzero until their owning contracts. Default no-argument invocation runs all currently implemented feature115 cases; existing fixtures_self_test CI job invokes it permanently. Later contracts extend default suite/cases; temporary scratch Git fixtures only, no tools/fixtures directory.
test_ownership: Test author, developer and acceptance reviewer are distinct recorded agents/sessions. Evaluator owns test bytes and any bounded scope checks. Independent reviewer freezes baseline source obligation/API and test bytes, captures intended baseline failure after setup succeeds, and approves before Generator source implementation. Changed bundle bytes require renewed independent review; no feature116 seal mechanism is implemented here.
